answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted attestation: each agent stakes a scarce ferrous-hard asset before its votes count, and peers who detect duplicate behaviour slash that bond. A sybil farm must lock real capital per identity, like planting an entire orchard that only fruits years later, while every fake identity earns a fraction of one honest agent's revenue. The asymmetry does the work: a plume of new accounts costs more than it can ever return.
